summary: Fase B tested end-to-end: backend (6/6 pytest passing) + UI. HardwareBridge simulation (scale + PLC), Food Cost 1-click da ricetta, and Auto-weather env compute all functional. 12 HoloPanels present, no crashes, no violet, admin gate + login regression OK.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py has grown to 12423 lines — strongly recommend splitting into feature modules (lab/, community/, hardware/, security/) for maintainability.
ScaleBridge simulate() ignores _stop flag on the setInterval (uses `if this._stop return` inside but still relies on clearInterval in disconnect); ok but could early-return earlier.
hw-cycle-send auto-invokes simulate() when no mode set — behavior is fine but could show explicit 'simulazione attiva' badge for clarity.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Fase B verified. Simulation scale updates every 250ms (step=target/60), semaforo transitions RED→AMBER→GREEN as weight approaches target — need ~10-15s wait to observe GREEN state at 500g target. Recipe select showed 150 mikilab recipes and auto-computed food-cost on select. env-auto uses Open-Meteo Stuttgart (~13.9°C/77%) and recomputes proof/hydration. No violet, no beep (only TTS).
